correctness.rationale: On K_{2,n} every cycle is generated by two full two-edge leaf arms, hence an acyclic edge set has at most one full arm. This exhaustive disjoint decomposition gives the exact partition, event moments, strictly positive covariance, and simple explicit derivative. A single Descartes sign variation establishes uniqueness for every n>=4. Root expansion yields t_n=1+22/(3n)+O(n^-2), and the rescaled maximum tends to 4/27. Independent exact-rational enumeration of 48 test identities corroborates, but does not replace, the all-size derivation.

value.rationale: The all-size noncactus family has a natural nonlocal disjoint-connection observable; a single delocalized hub-bridging leaf yields a strictly positive finite-size correlation of order 1/n. The unique activity optimizer is shifted above one by 22/(3n), while the sharp rescaled maximum tends to 4/27. This identifies a motivated finite-size correlation mechanism rather than an arbitrary enumerated graph value.
